description: Unit tests for ICMP packet creation and validation in the quiche project, specifically testing the creation of ICMPv6 packets and handling of non-zero checksums.

classes.name: icmp6_hdr
classes.description: Structure representing the ICMPv6 header used in packet creation.

methods.name: CreatedPacketMatchesReference
methods.description: Test verifying that the created ICMP packet matches a predefined reference packet.

methods.name: NonZeroChecksumIsIgnored
methods.description: Test verifying that a non-zero checksum in the ICMP header is ignored during packet creation.
